Name: Remove Sam's Mullet
Author: superlayne
Description: I really like Sam, I just didn't love his mullet. All this mod does is remove his mullet from his portraits. Just copy and paste the .xnb into the portraits folder in the steam/steamapps/common/stardew valley/content.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
